name: New visitor can sign in and choose a single ZINGO account type
description: Checks that account setup presents customer, restaurant and driver as distinct onboarding choices and does not expose role-switch tabs.
expected: The user profile is created with exactly one selected role. Customer accounts activate; restaurant and driver accounts enter pending approval.

name: Restaurant and driver accounts require NahaLabs approval
description: Checks that partner accounts cannot access operational workspaces before approval and that the NahaLabs admin can approve or reject applications.
steps: Register as a restaurant or driver
Sign in as the NahaLabs administrator
expected: Pending partner accounts remain blocked; only the allowlisted NahaLabs administrator can change application status.

name: Order endpoints enforce customer, restaurant and driver permissions
description: Checks that unauthenticated requests are rejected, customer records are isolated, restaurant status transitions are restricted and drivers can claim a ready delivery only once.
steps: Call order endpoints without signing in
Sign in as a customer and place an order
Sign in as a different customer and inspect order history
Sign in as the restaurant account and advance its order
Sign in as a driver and claim a ready delivery
expected: Unauthenticated and unauthorized requests are rejected. Users see only permitted orders and server-side transitions prevent cross-role updates.

name: Paystack remains clearly marked as unavailable for live checkout
description: Ensures the current pilot does not claim a real payment was taken.
expected: The app clearly states that checkout is a demo and no live payment is processed.
